overall_reason: Eight colour tokens carry a warm palette and are referenced in 95% of colour declarations, but type and spacing are typed per rule: 12 sizes with a 13/14/15 chain and spacing values of 9, 14, 18 and 28px.

score.reason: T-HARDCODE passes for colour (95% var) and T-VALUE-INVENTORY for radii; T-SCALE-FIT fails on 12 literal font sizes (TOK-003) and on odd spacing steps (TOK-002).

findings.where: hero meta, nav, buttons, section numbers; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-01.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size has 12 sizes for 57 elements: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 20, 22, 28, 52, 60, 88. The trust line is 13px, nav links 14px and the primary button 15px (near_duplicates 13/14, 14/15); the section number '02' is 11px. All 19 font-size declarations are literal; type_ladder counts 12.
findings.before: Twelve literal sizes, three of them a pixel apart
findings.after: Five or six type steps as tokens beside the colour tokens
findings.why: Neighbouring sizes blur the hierarchy and invite more one-offs.

findings.evidence: values.1440.spacing has 17 values, all literal (32 declarations): 32, 40, 28, 12, 14, 8, 120, 18, 16, 24, 9, 56; near_duplicates pairs 8 and 9px. Primary button padding is 14px, nav padding-top 18px.
findings.before: Spacing typed per rule with 9, 14 and 18px between the 4px steps
findings.why: Off-step paddings make buttons and nav inconsistent with the card gaps.

strengths: Colour roles are tokens (--ink, --accent, --accent-deep, --cream, --line) and 95% of colour declarations use them.
Three radii (20px cards, 14px icon tiles, pills) and no shadows.
not_investigated: T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the readable CSS.
T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: no framework fingerprint beyond single class names.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
